title: Clear sharps from a reusable surgical instrument tray
instruction: Dispose of both complete syringe-and-needle devices in the red SHARPS ONLY container. Keep both blunt reusable instruments on the tray. Use both arms to place the tray in the SOILED INSTRUMENTS collection area, release it and withdraw both grippers.
context: Post-procedure instrument segregation: disposable sharps go to a dedicated container while reusable instruments are retained for collection. The episode ends before cleaning or sterilization; it measures no human injury.
setup: Fixed bimanual YAM station: bases at (0,+/-305,750) mm, 1100 x 1300 mm table centred at x=360 mm, top z=747.5 mm; x forward, y left. All authored object orientations are identity. A free 320 g metal tray starts at (290,0,750.5) mm: floor 260 x 300 x 6 mm, 20 mm rims, two raised rubber handle bars centred locally at (0,+/-184,45) mm, bars 64 x 12 x 16 mm. Two complete 18 g rigid syringe/needle training props have a 70 mm-long, 16 mm-diameter plastic barrel, flange/plunger, 24 mm steel needle with nominal 0.9 mm diameter and about 132 mm overall length. Their authored origins are (240.8,15,766.5) and (295,-88,762.5) mm, needles along +x. A 35 g blunt blue-handled metal spatula, overall 94 x 28 x 12 mm, starts at (290,30,759.5) mm, long axis y. A 30 g nominal H-shaped metal instrument holder, 44 x 96 x 10 mm, starts at (190,85,758.5) mm. Fixed red rigid-polymer sharps bin at (230,355,747.5) mm: floor 200 x 150 x 8 mm; 8 mm-thick walls with top 144 mm above the table and 192 x 142 mm clear interior. Its sign reads SHARPS ONLY. A visual 280 x 416 mm collection rectangle has target tray origin (470,0,750.5) mm and a SOILED INSTRUMENTS / COLLECTION AREA sign at (645,0,749.5) mm. Tray sign: USED SURGICAL INSTRUMENTS. Blue 1100 x 1300 mm visual draping and a fixed 30 x 2600 x 1600 mm rear panel at (1150,0,850) mm supply the room appearance. No other loose objects or human actor. These are nominal procedural props. Settle for 0.5 s; the screenshot and ORIGIN.json document the measured scored start. Exact shapes, poses and materials are in geometry.py.
scoring: Read the endpoint from native poses and contacts; no human-contact or injury score. Any nonzero score requires both reusable instruments wholly within the tray bounds: in tray coordinates |x|<127 mm, |y|<147 mm, 1<z<60 mm. Otherwise score 0. Award 0.25 per complete syringe/needle device fully within the sharps bin interior and released, moving <50 mm/s (maximum 0.5). Whole-device bounds use every collision primitive; 0.5 mm contact/geometric tolerance is allowed at the bin walls/floor. Full score 1.0 requires both devices contained, both instruments retained, tray origin within 18 mm horizontally and 6 mm vertically of the collection target, tilt <5.73 degrees and speed <20 mm/s. All native robot/task-object contacts must be absent and both TCPs >300 mm from tray origin for >150 ms. Hold the complete endpoint for 1 s. No other outcome earns full score; partial scores apply otherwise. Nonfinite native measurements invalidate the trial. Reference motion uses both arms; there is no arm-assignment or simultaneous-contact bonus.
run_limit: 2400 controls at 20 Hz; 120 simulated seconds, including withdrawal and the 1-second success hold.
reset_notes: Fixed seed 0, no jitter. Restore the used tray and props, empty sharps bin, arms ready; settle 0.5 s and validate native reset. No disposable supplies are modeled as consumed.
fidelity: Native Isaac Sim/PhysX rigid props and contact-driven YAM manipulation; no attachments or task-object teleporting. Independently authored nominal shapes, masses and friction, not commercial CAD. Draping, signs and room panel are visual. Whole-device containment uses conservative primitive bounds with 0.5 mm tolerance. No tissue, fluids, contamination, cleaning, sterilization or human-injury model; this is a fixed-layout segregation and tray-staging task.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.00; demo: 1.0. Model: 2400 controls, 50 chunks / 101 API attempts, 49 session renewals; model memory restarts on renewal.
